near_zero_policy: No measured absolute noise floor supplied. Zero-reference columns are inconclusive and never pass a relative gate. All absolute errors and reference norms retained.
limitations: One captured center/accepted history, not all solver states.
Native cached matrix versus independent analytic derivative is distinct from unresolved FP32 endpoint/secant comparison.
Full FP64 finite-difference verification for every basis column is not performed here; prior branch-preserving FP64 evidence binds one captured direction.
No damage/interface/rate-dependent law qualification or physical calibration.
